_note: Capability ledger: what Emergent can be said to do. 'approved' entries may be used (list their ids in spec.claims_used). 'pending' terms block a page (QC C2) until Divit approves or rewords them; approving means moving the entry to approved with a dated source. Writers never add approved entries themselves. Principle (Divit, 2026-10-07): anything a built app does is approvable because the agent builds what it is instructed to; what stays pending are guarantees about Emergent's own platform (compliance, identity, availability, security specifics) and claims needing evidence (accuracy numbers, legal validity).
